notes: Experiment C: three-task Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct LoRA baseline.
Reads task-separated files under data/multitask_bloom_rewrite_capped; no merged JSONL is persisted.
All BloomShift training rows are retained; QA and summarization training rows are independently capped at 806 each using seed 42. No fixed-ratio batch sampler is configured.

BloomShift uses all 1,075 train rows, with 212 validation and 135 test rows held out. All-row inclusion is documented by the owner batch attestation; independent gold-review evidence is not established.

SQuAD and arXiv validation/test splits remain separately stored and are deterministically capped to BloomShift's corresponding held-out counts (212 validation, 135 test). The evaluator uses validation by default and must not use test for model selection.
8192 tokens is the fixed SFT sequence limit. The builder refuses overlength records rather than relying on training-time truncation.
Use a fresh output directory per experiment. Do not resume checkpoints from a different dataset or training condition.
